verses.gurmukhi: ਨਾਥਾਂ ਨਾਥੁ ਨ ਸੇਵਨੀ ਹੋਇ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁ ਚੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: naathaa(n) naath na sevanee hoi anaath guroo bahu chele|

en.bdb: Not serving the Lord (God) of Lords, many lords (naths) becoming gurus initiate people as their disciples.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕੰਨ ਪੜਾਇ ਬਿਭੂਤਿ ਲਾਇ ਖਿੰਥਾ ਖਪਰੁ ਡੰਡਾ ਹੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ka(n)n paRai bibhoot lai khi(n)thaa khapar dda(n)ddaa hele|

en.bdb: They getting the ears split and applying ashes on their bodies carry begging bowls and staff.

verses.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਟੁਕਰ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਸਿੰਙੀ ਨਾਦੁ ਵਾਜਾਇਨਿ ਭੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: ghar ghar Tukar ma(n)gadhe si(n)n(g)ee naadh vaajain bhele|

en.bdb: Going from door to door, they beg food and blow their singi, a special instrument made of horn.

verses.gurmukhi: ਭੁਗਤਿ ਪਿਆਲਾ ਵੰਡੀਐ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਵਰਾਤੀ ਮੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: bhugat piaalaa va(n)ddeeaai sidh saadhik sivaraatee mele|

en.bdb: Getting together on the Sivaratri fair they share with one another the food and the cup of drinks.

verses.gurmukhi: ਬਾਰਹ ਪੰਥ ਚਲਾਇਦੇ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟੀ ਖਰੇ ਦੁਹੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: baareh pa(n)th chalaidhe baareh vaaTee khare dhuhele|

en.bdb: They follow one of the twelve sects (of yogis) and go on moving on these twelve ways i.e. they go on transmigrating.

verses.gurmukhi: ਵਿਣੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦ ਨ ਸਿਝਨੀ ਬਾਜੀਗਰ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਜੀ ਖੇਲੇ।
verses.translit_en: vin gur sabadh na sijhanee baajeegar kar baajee khele|

en.bdb: Without the word of the Guru, none gets liberated and all of them run here and there like acrobats.
This way the blind one goes on pushing the blind into the well.
